title: oxalis psoraleoides subsp. insipida
intro: Oxalis psoraleoides subsp. insipida, commonly known as the Bitter Oxalis or Bitter Wood Sorrel, is a plant species within the wood sorrel family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and culinary properties, offering health benefits such as aiding digestion and providing relief from various gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Oxalis psoraleoides subsp. insipida include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
